text: Saanvi - flat viewing in Leith sat morning. nervous re: deposit. text her that evening, see how it went
Kieran = Spurs season ticket, been going since he was 8. hates Arsenal w/ a passion lol
Lukas & Nora moving to Bristol end of the month. van booked. I'm helping w/ boxes the day before
Ravi - dad's 70th @ the Indian place on Brick Lane, sometime early March. Ravi wants a group gift, maybe chip in
remind me to ring Chiara the day before her move, she's stressing about the keys
Delroy into vinyl - mostly 70s dub + lovers rock. hunting a Dennis Brown first press. gift idea??
Tendai's sister Lwazi got into Edinburgh for medicine!! starts Sept. send congrats
gym 7am / dentist 2pm / pick up parcel @ post office before 5
Aditi - housewarming fri 8ish, new place in Walthamstow. bring wine. her flatmate Pooja does the cooking apparently
Kenji Ito - plays Go competitively, ranked 3 dan. tournament in Leeds over the summer. ask how it went afterwards

Ximena moving back to Bogotá sometime next yr. mum not well. check in w/ her next week
Angela + husband - 25th anniv in June, renewing vows. invite should come sometime in spring
don't forget: Nasser's driving test thurs. text good luck that morning, then ask how it went the next day
Idris: new job @ Arup from Mon, structural eng. moving to Manchester for it. flat in Ancoats
Yaw - Chelsea mad, has the 2012 Munich shirt framed. watching the CL final at his. I'm doing the snacks
Shanice's cat Biscuit went missing tues. back now but limping, vet tomorrow. she was in bits
Aleksander's partner Michael - sourdough obsessed, feeds the starter every night. vegan too, note for dinner

call w/ Dev re: flat in Peckham. viewing went ok - 1-bed above a launderette, bit noisy but 10 min from his work. offer in by fri. landlord wants 6 mo upfront?! he's skint after the van + deposit on the last place that fell through. his gf Shanice might move in w/ him eventually, not decided. ask him a week after if they accepted
need to sort council tax + change address on driving licence before end of month
Kalani - ukulele band, gig @ the Hope & Anchor 2nd Sat of Nov. she's terrified, first time singing lead. wish her luck day before
Rhys & his gf Nora got engaged!!! in Lisbon. wedding prob summer 2028
Vikram Shah - dad's knee op wk of the 10th. Vikram taking time off, stressed re work. message him afterwards to see how dad's doing
Mateo - finished the whole Wheel of Time series, 14 books. now on Malazan. recommends Gardens of the Moon
Aneesh's move to Glasgow is off - job fell through. staying in Croydon for now. bit gutted
Pooja - lives in Hackney w/ 2 flatmates + a rabbit called Pickle. works in UX @ Monzo
Ayo: exam results thurs, mocks didn't go great. her mum's on her case. check in w/ her that evening
buy new bike lights. order birthday card for Ravi's dad by early March
Adebayo Okafor - Warhammer 40k, Ultramarines army, paints minis every Sunday. tournament in Nottingham sometime in Jan
Lukas - first night in Bristol flat, boiler already dead lol. remind me to send him the plumber's number tomorrow
Chiara got the flat!!! Clapham, 2-bed w/ garden. moving 1st Dec. her dog Rolo finally gets a garden
Saanvi - viewing sat went fine but flat was damp. still looking, Edinburgh or maybe Glasgow. ask her mid-Nov if anything's come up
Kieran's brother Dev - climbing, bouldering mostly @ the Castle. trip to Fontainebleau over Easter
Delroy's mum passed last week. funeral thurs @ 11. I'm going w/ Angela. card + flowers before
Nasser - passed!!! 1st time, 2 minors. buying a Fiat 500 apparently

Kenji @ lunch - his wife's expecting, due early Feb!! first one. he's nervous about the move to the bigger flat before then - 3-bed in Stoke Newington, sometime over Xmas, exact date tbc w/ the agent. his parents flying in from Osaka the week after the baby arrives so they need the spare room sorted. offer to help w/ the van + flatpack. he likes those Japanese whisky miniatures, gift for the baby arriving?
Tendai - Arsenal season ticket, north bank. has a 1-yr-old daughter. back at work after paternity leave mon
Marcus's bday - he dropped hints about a Lego Botanical set. the orchid one. get by 10th
Aditi's housewarming was great. her boyfriend Rhys made cocktails. follow up re the book club she mentioned, 1st meeting end of month
self: viewing Thursday 6pm, 2 Elm Rd. bring payslips + ID. ask about parking

Florin - into chess properly, plays on lichess every night after work. 1900 blitz, wants 2000 by xmas. his dad taught him in Cluj, they still play correspondence games. he follows the Candidates religiously, big Nepo fan. said he'd teach me some openings. also mentioned he's flat hunting again after the last one fell through, ideally Hackney, end of the month latest
Idris's first week @ Arup - he's struggling, knows no one in Manchester. ring him sat, maybe visit sometime next month

Ximena - mum's scan results came back ok, finally. Ximena relieved but still flying out to Bogotá early Dec for 3 wks, maybe longer. her brother Mateo staying here to look after the flat + their cat Luna. she's been really low the last couple months, not sleeping. ask her before she goes if she needs anything - lifts to Heathrow, plant watering, whatever. and message her the week after she lands

Angela - did the Great North Run, 2:04! knocked 11 min off last yr. her knee held up after the physio stuff in the summer. training for London next April now, raising money for Macmillan bc of her dad. long runs sundays w/ her running club in Victoria Park. send congrats + sponsor her when the page goes live
Aleksander + Michael's leaving do fri - moving to Berlin, Michael's job. drinks @ the Lexington from 7. get them a card
Vikram - new allotment. growing chillies, 12 types. obsessed

Shanice - band practice moved to weds. her bassist Lwazi quit, he got a job in Leeds. so they're auditioning new ppl sometime next week, 3 lined up. she's sad about it, they started the band at uni. playing a lot of Fontaines DC covers + their own stuff, first proper EP out early spring hopefully. offered to help w/ the cover art
remind me: Ravi's flat viewing in Shoreditch tues. text him that evening, then if he goes for it, help him measure up the week after
Mateo's band split up. he's taking it hard, 6 yrs together. drinks sometime next week, my shout
Kalani - wedding in Hawaii next July, her cousin's. she's going for 3 wks. wants recs for a decent snorkel
council tip sat. then IKEA for shelving. then nothing
Michael - Dr Jensen now!! PhD viva passed last month. graduation in Jan. Aleksander so proud

Dev's mum retiring - party end of Nov, 40 yrs teaching at the same primary in Ealing. Dev organising the whole thing, says he's out of his depth. venue = the cricket club, about 60 ppl incl ex-pupils. she loves Motown + old Bollywood so help w/ playlist. also she wants to take up pottery afterwards, so a voucher for a wheel class might go down well
Yaw's son starts nursery mon. Yaw dreading drop off. text him that morning

Pooja + Aditi heading to Japan over the summer, 2 wks. Tokyo, Kyoto, then up to Hokkaido. Pooja's done a spreadsheet itinerary, colour coded obvs. Aditi wants more onsen + less temples. they're both into Ghibli so the museum is booked. ask Kenji for food recs and send them over. ask them after how it was

Adebayo's moving house - Leyton to Walthamstow, sat 23rd. he's asked if I can drive the second load in the afternoon. most of it is his Warhammer stuff + paint rack so careful w/ the boxes. his housemate Kieran left already, so it's just him + his cousin. need to check the car's ok the day before + clear the boot. and remind me to bring takeaway round that evening, he'll be knackered
Nora - crochet. making blankets for the baby unit @ Homerton. her mum taught her
Aneesh Banerjee (Neesh) - cricket mad, plays for Croydon 2nds. season over now. nets start again early March
Chiara's moving day - all went smoothly, Rolo loves the garden. her parents up from Bari for a wk. housewarming sometime in Jan, she'll confirm. remind me to get them a plant afterwards
